payload.content: A technical-services WordPress website helping customers identify plumbing, installation-technology and metalwork support before moving to contact or quotation.
payload.description_1: Customers may arrive with a leak, heating or installation issue, or a metal repair, without knowing which technical discipline applies. Focusing the site mainly on custom metalwork would hide two major service areas and make the first choice unnecessarily difficult.
payload.description_2: I arranged the site around three clear service routes: plumbing, installation technology and metalwork. Each route explains the relevant jobs and practical context before contact or quotation, so visitors can start from the problem they recognise instead of interpreting a broad technical-services message.
